SELECT seq_planner.CURRVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO planner ( m_id, pln_title, start_date, end_date, total_days, lDongRegnCd, lDongSignguCd, is_public, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{mId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{plnTitle, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{startDate, jdbcType=DATE}, #{endDate, jdbcType=DATE}, #{totalDays, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{lDongRegnCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{lDongSignguCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{isPublic, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE planner SET pln_title = #{plnTitle, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, start_date = #{startDate, jdbcType=DATE}, end_date = #{endDate, jdbcType=DATE}, total_days = #{totalDays, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, lDongRegnCd = #{lDongRegnCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, lDongSignguCd = #{lDongSignguCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, is_public = #{isPublic, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE pln_id = #{plnId}
mapper.select: SELECT p.pln_id, p.m_id, m.m_nickname AS author_nickname, p.pln_title, p.start_date, p.end_date, p.total_days, p.lDongRegnCd, p.lDongSignguCd, r.regn_name || ' ' || NVL(s.signgu_name, '') AS region_name, p.share_link, p.is_public, p.created_at, p.updated_at, NVL((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM favorite_planner WHERE pln_id = p.pln_id), 0) AS favorite_count FROM planner p LEFT JOIN member m ON p.m_id = m.m_id LEFT JOIN ldong_regn_code r ON p.lDongRegnCd = r.lDongRegnCd LEFT JOIN ldong_signgu_code s ON p.lDongRegnCd = s.lDongRegnCd AND p.lDongSignguCd = s.lDongSignguCd WHERE p.pln_id = #{plnId}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT p.pln_id, p.m_id, m.m_nickname AS author_nickname, p.pln_title, p.start_date, p.end_date, p.total_days, r.regn_name AS region_name, p.is_public, p.created_at, ( SELECT d.firstimage FROM planner_day pd JOIN planner_place pp ON pd.day_id = pp.day_id JOIN destination d ON pp.contentid = d.contentid WHERE pd.pln_id = p.pln_id AND pp.sort_order = 1 AND pd.day_number = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1 ) AS thumbnail_image, NVL((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM favorite_planner WHERE pln_id = p.pln_id), 0) AS favorite_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY p.created_at DESC) AS rnum FROM planner p LEFT JOIN member m ON p.m_id = m.m_id LEFT JOIN ldong_regn_code r ON p.lDongRegnCd = r.lDongRegnCd WHERE p.m_id = #{mId} ) WHERE rnum BETWEEN #{offset} + 1 AND #{offset} + #{size}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM planner WHERE m_id = #{mId}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT p.pln_id, p.m_id, m.m_nickname AS author_nickname, p.pln_title, p.start_date, p.end_date, p.total_days, r.regn_name AS region_name, p.is_public, p.created_at, ( SELECT d.firstimage FROM planner_day pd JOIN planner_place pp ON pd.day_id = pp.day_id JOIN destination d ON pp.contentid = d.contentid WHERE pd.pln_id = p.pln_id AND pp.sort_order = 1 AND pd.day_number = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1 ) AS thumbnail_image, NVL((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM favorite_planner WHERE pln_id = p.pln_id), 0) AS favorite_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM favorite_planner WHERE pln_id = p.pln_id) DESC, p.created_at DESC ) AS rnum FROM planner p LEFT JOIN member m ON p.m_id = m.m_id LEFT JOIN ldong_regn_code r ON p.lDongRegnCd = r.lDongRegnCd WHERE p.is_public = 1 ) WHERE rnum BETWEEN #{offset} + 1 AND #{offset} + #{size}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM planner WHERE is_public = 1

SELECT p.pln_id, p.m_id, m.m_nickname AS author_nickname, p.pln_title, p.start_date, p.end_date, p.total_days, p.lDongRegnCd, p.lDongSignguCd, r.regn_name || ' ' || NVL(s.signgu_name, '') AS region_name, p.share_link, p.is_public, p.created_at, p.updated_at, NVL((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM favorite_planner WHERE pln_id = p.pln_id), 0) AS favorite_count FROM planner p LEFT JOIN member m ON p.m_id = m.m_id LEFT JOIN ldong_regn_code r ON p.lDongRegnCd = r.lDongRegnCd LEFT JOIN ldong_signgu_code s ON p.lDongRegnCd = s.lDongRegnCd AND p.lDongSignguCd = s.lDongSignguCd WHERE p.share_link = #{shareLink}
mapper.update: UPDATE planner SET share_link = #{shareLink, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE pln_id = #{plnId}
